title: Initial focus for our partnership with Motorola is a regular non-folding device
summary: GrapheneOS announces partnership with Motorola, with initial focus on a regular non-folding device. This marks an expansion of GrapheneOS's hardware support beyond its traditional Pixel device focus, bringing its privacy and security hardened Android distribution to Motorola hardware.
problem_solved: Expands availability of privacy-focused mobile operating system beyond Google Pixel devices to Motorola hardware.
why_valuable: Provides privacy-conscious users with more hardware choices while maintaining GrapheneOS's enhanced security hardening and privacy protections.
